items.title: 18.7.3 Ligand exchange ka complexes ke rang par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the effect of ligand exchange on colour (PDF 29-30).

blocks.text: Ligands badalne se dhaat ke ion ke d orbitals ki splitting, delta E, ki miqdar badal jati hai. Is liye jazb hone wali roshni ki frequency aur nazar aane wala rang bhi badalta hai. Har soorat mein naye ligands (NH3 ya Cl-) asal H2O ligands se zyada mustahkam complex banate hain, jis ka delta E aur is liye rang mukhtalif hota hai.

blocks.caption: Ligand exchange aur rang ki tabdeeli (kitab ka Table 18.4)

blocks.prompt: [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2](s) ke zaid ammonia mein ghulne ka mua'adla likhein.
Gulabi [Co(H2O)6]2+ conc. HCl se neela ho jata hai. d orbital splitting se wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Chaar Cl- chhe H2O ki jagah lete aur octahedral ion tetrahedral [CoCl4]2- ban jata hai. Cl- H2O se kam splitting karta aur tetrahedral splitting waise bhi kam hai, is liye delta E ghat'ta hai; complex kam tawanai ki (surkh/narangi) roshni jazb karta aur neela dikhta hai.

blocks.prompt: [Co(H2O)6]2+ + 4Cl- -> [CoCl4]2- + 6H2O mein product ka coordination number aur shakal batayein.

items: Naye ligands delta E badalte, is liye jazb frequency aur rang badalte.
